title.zh: 【Polymarket 已调查数十起中期选举相关内幕交易案件】
title.en: 【Polymarket 已调查数十起中期选举相关内幕交易案件】

current_state.zh: Polymarket has investigated dozens of midterm-election-related insider-trading cases, referring at least two to the CFTC while using a new real-time election monitoring system that analyzes social media, FEC data, and crypto trading records.
